name: tt-model-op-analysis
description: Kernel-op analysis of one implementation of a tt-metal model on its architecture (Blackhole, Wormhole or Quasar), with destinations, resumable measurements (Tracy, ttnn graph capture, kernel cache via elfray, TTsim), and a separate Google Sheets upload skill.

interface.shortDescription: List every kernel op one implementation of a tt-metal model runs and how each ports to other architectures, statically and with Tracy and TTsim measurements.
interface.longDescription: One skill analyses the kernel ops of one implementation of a model on its source profile (P100, P150, N150, one chip of an N300, or Quasar) at a pinned tt-metal commit: every ttnn call of the entry test traced to its device op and program factory, with support decided per kernel op. Destinations (another profile running the same code, or a Quasar BF16 projection) are added to the same run without re-tracing. Measurements are resumable items: a Tracy run of the entry test on the source device and TTsim runs of Quasar kernel-op tests, on the run's commit. Output is CSV with a per-kernel-op summary. A second skill uploads finished runs to Google Sheets.
capabilities: Tracy measurement of the entry test
Google Sheets upload of a run
defaultPrompt: Start a kernel-op analysis: ask me for the model, show its existing runs, then continue one or start a new run.
Upload a kernel-op analysis run to Google Drive.
